• change the fixed maturity of any such securities;

• reduce the rate of interest on such securities;

seltz.snippet:
The "Effect of Supplemental Indentures" clause defines how amendments or additions made through supplemental indentures impact the original agreement. Typically, this clause clarifies that any changes introduced by a supplemental indenture become part of the original indenture and are binding on all parties, such as the issuer and bondholders. Its core practical function is to ensure that modifications are seamlessly integrated into the existing contract, maintaining legal continuity and preventing disputes over which terms govern the parties' rights and obligations.
